title: Near Mosque: Lokutan Sallah
shortDescription: Lokutan sallah, kiran sallah, Alƙibla da masallaci mafi kusa. Babu talla.
fullDescription:
Near Mosque yana nuna lokutan sallah na yau a garinku, yana nuna muku Alƙibla, kuma yana nemo masallatan da ke kewaye da ku. Ana lissafin lokutan sallah da Alƙibla a na'urarku, don haka suna aiki ba tare da intanet ba.

LOKUTAN SALLAH
• Sallah ta gaba da sauran lokaci, a kan sararin sama da ke bin lokacin yini
• Sararin sama bisa yanayi (na zaɓi): yanayin yau a garin sallarku, a sararin sama sama da lokutan sallah, tare da zafin jiki da iska. A kashe yake har sai kun kunna shi; sannan ana aika wurin garin, da aka zagaye zuwa kusan kilomita 1, ga MET Norway. Yanayi: bisa bayanai daga MET Norway (CC BY 4.0).
• Hanyoyin lissafi 11, La'asar ta yau da kullum ko ta Hanafi, kwanan watan Hijira da gyaran mintuna na kowace sallah
• Kiran sallah daga Masallacin Harami ko Masallacin Annabi, cikakke ko gajere, tunatarwa kafin kowace sallah, da ƙararrawar Asuba
• Bayan kiran sallah, ƙidaya zuwa iƙama da sanarwa a lokacin iƙama; kuna iya canza lokacin jira
• Shiru lokacin sallah (a kashe har sai kun kunna): manhajar tana kunna "Kar a damu" don sallah, sannan ta kashe bayan haka

ALƘIBLA
• Kamfas da ke juyawa tare da wayarku kuma yana gaya muku lokacin da kuke fuskantar Ka'aba
• Hanya da nisa zuwa Makka daga garinku

MASALLACI MAFI KUSA
• Masallatan da ke kewaye da ku a taswira ko kamfas, tare da nisa da kwatance
• Ana neman masallatai ta intanet, kuma manhajar tana ɗauke da bayanan masallatan Alkahira, London da Cape Town

TAMBAYA GAME DA MUSULUNCI
• Ku yi tambaya kuma ku karanta amsar daga ɗakin karatu na manhajar, tare da tushen kowane nassi
• Tambayoyinku suna zama a na'urarku. Amsoshi suna ɗauko daga littattafai; ba fatawa ba ne.

ƊAKIN KARATU
• Fatawowin Sheikh Ibn Baz, hadisai, fassarorin Alƙur'ani da tafsiri, da littattafan IslamHouse
• Littattafan Larabci na gargajiya a akida, hadisi, fiƙihu, tafsiri da sira, ana sauke kowanne sau ɗaya kuma a karanta ba tare da intanet ba

WIDGET NA ALLON GIDA
• Widget 8: sallah ta gaba, ƙidayar sallah, zoben sallah, sallolin yau, masallaci mafi kusa, Alƙibla, tambaya game da Musulunci da ayyuka masu sauri
• Salo ɗaya na manhaja da kowane widget: zinariya da kirim, kore, sararin dare, shuɗi-kore ko bisa lokaci

HAKANAN A KAN
iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows da Linux.

SIRRI
Babu asusu, babu talla, babu bibiya. Manhajar tana shiga intanet ne kawai don neman masallatai (da wurin da aka zagaye), nuna taswira, sauke abin da kuka nema, buɗe hanyoyin haɗin da kuka zaɓa, da kuma, idan kun kunna "Sararin sama bisa yanayi", samo yanayin garinku.

Harsuna 36.
whatsNew: Sabon rangadin maraba, inda 'yan amsoshi kaɗan ke shirya ranar sallarku: garinku, lokacin da La'asar ke farawa, kiran sallah, tunatarwar Juma'a, sararin yanayi da salonku. Layin yanayi yanzu yana nuna alama. Gyare-gyare: harshen da kuka zaɓa a cikin manhajar yanzu yana bayyana gaba ɗaya, "Yi amfani da wurina" ya fi sauri a cikin gida, kuma Haske ko Duhu yana aiki nan take.
